transcript:
Agent: Good afternoon ma'am, this is Rohan from Aster Vale Care. You had filled a form with us.
Customer: Yes, I wanted to know if you treat hair fall. I have a lot of hair fall.
Agent: Ma'am, we are a pain clinic. Do you have any pain anywhere, back, knee, neck?
Customer: No, no pain at all. Only hair fall. I thought you were a skin clinic.
Agent: Okay ma'am, then we won't be able to help with that. Sorry ma'am.
Customer: Okay, no problem. Bye.

Agent: Hello sir, Amit from Aster Vale Pain Clinic. You had enquired about neck pain.
Customer: Yes, but I live permanently in Toronto. I am not coming to India at all.
Agent: Sir, we can also do an online consultation with our doctor.
Customer: No, I don't want any online consultation. I only do in-person treatment, here in Toronto.
Agent: Understood sir. We don't have any centre there.
Customer: Then it won't work. Thank you.

Agent: Hello sir, Ravi from Aster Vale Pain Clinic, about your knee pain enquiry.
Customer: I am busy right now.
Agent: No problem sir, shall I call you tomorrow at 5 pm?
Customer: Okay.
Agent: Great sir, and the consultation fee is 800.
Customer: Actually no. I don't want this. Remove my number and don't call me again.
Agent: Okay sir, I will remove your number.

Agent: Hello ma'am, Arjun from Aster Vale Pain Clinic, about your knee pain.
Customer: Yes. I want to meet the doctor but I am free only after the 18th.
Agent: Okay ma'am. The doctor is available on the 20th at 11 am.
Customer: The 20th at 11 am is fine. Please book it.
Agent: Confirmed ma'am, the 20th of November at 11 am at our Cedar Square clinic.
Customer: Okay, thank you.

Agent: Hello sir, Simran from Aster Vale Pain Clinic about your back pain.
Customer: Which doctor will see me? I will only come if it is a senior specialist.
Agent: Sir, all our doctors are pain specialists.
Customer: That's not an answer. Only if you tell me the doctor's experience will I come. Otherwise forget it.
Agent: Okay sir, I will check the doctor's details and call you.

Agent: Hello sir, Tanvi from Aster Vale Pain Clinic about your neck pain.
Customer: Call me tomorrow at 11.
Agent: Okay sir, tomorrow at 11.
Customer: Actually, don't call tomorrow. I'm not sure when I'll be free. I will call you myself when I can.
Agent: Okay sir, no problem.
